title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

reports.title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

summary:
On Aug. 3 in a Cypress neighborhood, Harris County sheriff's deputies stopped two 19-year-olds, Anthony and Julian, after mistaking their Camaro for a stolen car. Deputies drew guns, handcuffed them, and at least five patrol cars and a helicopter were involved. The sheriff's office said license plate cameras had flagged a stolen Camaro linked to aggravated robberies, but deputies and the helicopter could not read the plates on the car they stopped. After the men were handcuffed, deputies realized it was the wrong car.

Julian said a deputy pushed him down and he had cuts and scrapes. Anthony's mother, Leslie, wants deputies held accountable and plans to hire an attorney. The sheriff's office said supervisors, including the district captain, shift lieutenants, and shift sergeants, will review body-worn camera video to check whether procedures were followed. The men were given information about filing a formal complaint with internal affairs, and both plan to do so.
title_en: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say
